Subject: Stormline Shell is back in stock
Preview: 20k/20k waterproof and breathable. 420 g. Ready when your next trip is.
Body: If you've been waiting on the Stormline Shell (NB-JKT-07), it's back.

A quick recap of what it's built for: sustained wet weather. The 3-layer laminate construction and 20,000 mm waterproof rating handle extended rain without soaking through. The 20,000 g/m² breathability rating keeps moisture from building up inside during sustained effort — hiking, scrambling, moving through exposed terrain.

At 420 g, it packs down without taking over your kit.

What it isn't: it's not an insulating layer, and it's not sized for extreme alpine conditions beyond its rated specs. It does one job — keep rain out while you keep moving — and it does it well.

Sizes have moved fast across the previous restocks. If your size is there, now is the time.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.
